landing.nichesNote: Each niche pack needs testing with a real product in that niche before it is used for AI generation.
landing.plansNote: Premium price is decided by the owner and is not set yet. The free pack is complete and usable, with no watermark.

builder.heading: Listing pack builder
builder.step1Task: Upload the real product and confirm the facts. The check reads what you upload.
builder.uploadHelp: Sheet PDFs, screenshots, or renders of the actual product. PDF, JPG, or PNG.
builder.priceListLabel: List price (smallest currency unit, for example 1000 means 10.00)
builder.step4Help: Copy is generated only from your confirmed facts. Edit anything before export.
builder.step5Help: The preview updates live. The check must pass before export.
builder.replaceSampleButton: Replace sample content with my real product

builder.shareButton: Create a read only share link
builder.shareHelp: A partner or reviewer can view and comment. They cannot edit your pack.

profile.heading: Seller profile
profile.help: One profile per account. It is reused across listing packs, so you do not retype shop details, product facts, or branding for every new pack.

settings.heading: Account settings
settings.deletionHelp: Deleting your account deletes your listing packs, uploads, exports, and AI logs. This cannot be undone.
settings.deletionRequested: Deletion requested. You will receive a completion record when it is done.
